metadata.title: The 1st Graph-Based Tajweed App

articulation_point_description.jauf: The empty space within the mouth and throat cavity.
articulation_point_description.aqsha_halq: The deepest part of the throat (furthest from the mouth), specifically at the vocal cords (larynx).
articulation_point_description.wasath_halq: The middle part of the throat, specifically at the epiglottis.
articulation_point_description.adna_halq: The closest part of the throat (nearest to the mouth), where the root of the tongue meets the uvula.
articulation_point_description.aqsha_lisan: The back of the tongue touching the soft palate (the fleshy part of the roof of the mouth).
articulation_point_description.aqsha_lisan_asfal: The back of the tongue (slightly below the Qaf articulation point) touching the junction of the soft and hard palates.
articulation_point_description.wasath_lisan: The middle of the tongue rising to the roof of the mouth. (Touching for Jim; rising without touching for Shin and Ya).
articulation_point_description.hafah_lisan: The edge of the tongue (extending from the back to the tip) pressing against the inner wall of the upper molars on the left, right, or both.
articulation_point_description.adna_hafah_lisan: The nearest part of the tongue's edge (from the end of the Dhad articulation point to the tip) touching the palate near the gums of the upper incisors.
articulation_point_description.tharaf_lisan: The tip of the tongue touching the palate near the gums of the upper incisors (slightly below the Lam articulation point).
articulation_point_description.tharaf_lisan_zhahr_adkhal: The tip of the tongue slightly curling into the back of the tongue (close to the Nun articulation point).
articulation_point_description.tharaf_lisan_ulya_tsanaya: The tip of the tongue touching the base (root) of the upper incisors.
articulation_point_description.tharaf_lisan_tsanaya_sufla: The tip of the tongue positioned just above the lower incisors (without touching).
articulation_point_description.tharaf_lisan_athraf_tsanaya_ulya: The tip of the tongue touching the cutting edge of the upper incisors.
articulation_point_description.bathn_syafah: The inner part of the lower lip touching the cutting edge of the upper incisors.
articulation_point_description.syafatain: The two lips. (Rounding lips for Waw; Closing lips for Ba; Closing lips with ghunnah for Mim).
articulation_point_description.khaisyum: The nasal cavity (base of the nose), from where the Ghunnah (nasal sound) of Nun and Mim is emitted.

trait_description.jahr: The stoppage of breath flow (audible/clear sound).
trait_description.tawassuth: The moderate flow of sound (between Syiddah and Rakhawah).
trait_description.istila: The elevation of the back of the tongue.
trait_description.istifal: The lowering of the back of the tongue.
trait_description.itbaq: The tongue elevates until it almost adheres to the palate, causing the sound to be trapped.
trait_description.infitah: The opening of the space between the tongue and the palate.
trait_description.idzlaq: Easier and faster to pronounce due to proximity to the tip of the tongue or lips.
trait_description.lin: Softness. (Waw or Ya with Sukoon preceded by a Fathah).
trait_description.inhiraf: Drifting. (The sound drifts from its articulation point).
trait_description.takrir: A gentle trill/repetition of the tongue tip.
trait_description.tafasyi: Spreading of air throughout the mouth.
trait_description.istithalah: Elongation of the sound from the beginning to the end of the tongue's edge.
trait_description.ghunnah: A nasal sound emitted from the nasal cavity.
trait_description.tafkhim: A thick (heavy) sound caused by the elevation of the back of the tongue. There are 7 letters that are always pronounced thick, namely the letters possessing the trait of Isti'la.
trait_description.tarqiq: A thin (light) sound caused by the lowering of the back of the tongue. There are 19 letters that are always pronounced thin (letters with Istifal), except for Alif, Lam, and Ra, as these three can be pronounced thick or thin depending on the condition.
trait_description.others: Some characteristics have not been added yet; inshaa Allah, they will be added soon.
